hook_text: One third of the route or one fifth? Two runners, one fun run, and the answer surprises most people.
clip_script: Fun run in Durban. Same route for everyone. Sipho has run one third, Lerato one fifth. 5 is bigger than 3, so Lerato is ahead? No! Cut the route into 3 and each piece is long. Cut it into 5 and each piece is short. Sipho is ahead. With one on top, bigger bottom means smaller piece. Now the juice: five eighths full or three eighths full? Same size pieces, so more pieces win: five eighths. Two thirds or two fifths? Same number of pieces, bigger pieces win: two thirds. Stuck? Check against a half. Three eighths is under, four sevenths is over. Done.
visual_style: Whiteboard running route split into thirds and fifths with two runner dots; juice bottles filling; a halfway flag on a strip.
pacing: The race puzzle, the reveal, two quick juice rules, then the half check.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and order five fractions from your fraction wall.
